# Lightly Obscured

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Vision and Senses](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#LightlyObscured)*

You have [Disadvantage](../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md) on Wisdom ([Perception](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#Skills)) checks to see something in a Lightly Obscured space. *See also* "[Dim Light](Dim-Light.md)" and "Playing the Game" ("[Exploration](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#Light)").
